messages:
maya: Quick sync: designing the automatic fallback UX for rollouts. Goals: make it safe, readable, and auditable. Thoughts on surface area?

dev_chris: Keep the top-level flow simple: mode selector, traffic slider, triggers summary, audit toggle. Advanced JSON for power users hidden under an ‘advanced’ link.

linh: UI knobs I want visible: mode (soft/hard/sampled), fallback % (with canary presets: 5%, 20%, 100%), cooldown, trigger window, and a dry-run button.

product_ana: Audit needs to capture decision_id, policy_version, trigger_snapshot, and operator metadata for manual overrides. Customers will request CSV/JSON export.

maya: Canary presets are good. Also add an oscillation detector: when policy flips more than 3x in 10m, surface a recommended action and pause auto-escalation until acknowledged.

linh: Minimal event record we should emit per decision: decision_id | policy_version | trigger_reason | trigger_values | action | route. Keep a link to raw metrics blob rather than embedding big blobs.

dev_chris: For replayability we need deterministic inputs: include metric window timestamps and model_version. If randomness affects routing, stash rng_seed.

product_ana: UX copy: explain why fallback happened in plain language and show the raw numbers on hover. E.g., "Triggered: p99 latency 920ms (threshold 800ms) over 2min".

maya: Safety: require strong confirm for actions that change >50% traffic or switch to hard-switchover. Add a justification field that becomes part of the audit record.

ops-bot: Example override API for docs:
```bash
curl -X POST https://console.redwood.ai/api/v1/rollouts/override \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"decision_id":"auto-1805550000-xyz","override_action":"route_canary","justify":"incident mitigation","manual":true}'
```

linh: Policy preview: show estimated cost delta if fallback is used (tokens & latency impact). Teams will tune fallback_pct to balance SLOs and cost.

dev_chris: Also let teams scope policy: global, region, route. UI should show inheritance and allow per-region overrides with a small map/scoped list.

maya: Replay feature: click a decision timeline point -> open trace -> run replay that re-evaluates rules against stored metric slices in a sandbox. Mark replay results (match/mismatch).

product_ana: Access control: RBAC for audit/export and separate role for manual overrides. Enterprise customers require retention controls.

linh: Proposed lightweight policy snippet for display (read-only unless advanced):
```
mode: sampled-fallback
fallback_pct: 5
triggers:
  - error_rate > 2% over 60s
  - p99_latency > 800ms over 120s
cooldown: 300s
audit: enabled, sample=1.0
```

maya: Telemetry names we agreed: rollout.decision, rollout.replay, rollout.override, rollout.oscillation. Tag each event with severity and retention_class.

dev_chris: Next steps: linh will draft event schema PR, maya will write UX acceptance tests (oscillation, partial-region fail, noisy flaps), product_ana drafts customer-facing notes, ops-bot will spin RFC.

ops-bot: RFC: go/redwood/rfcs/auto-fallback-ui-2024 (draft created).

maya: Thanks team  I'll post mockups once I finish the acceptance criteria.

dev_chris: Ping when mockups are ready, I'll add telemetry hooks to the PR.

linh: Starting schema PR now.

product_ana: I'll prepare the FAQ blurb for customers and include known caveats.

maya: Closing thread  DM if anything urgent pops up.
